question_cn: 法国防御中黑方不立刻走c5，而是先稳固阵型（Nf6、Be7、a6等），再择机走c5反击。「延迟反击」的优势是什么？
question_en: In the French Defense, Black may prepare with ...Nf6, ...Be7, and ...a6 before playing ...c5. What is the benefit of delaying the counterattack?

options.text_cn: 延迟反击是因为黑方找不到好棋，只能拖延
options.text_en: Black delays because it has no good moves and must wait.

options.text_cn: 等待阵型稳固后再反击，确保反击时子力配合充分、反击效果最大化
options.text_en: Stabilize the position and coordinate the pieces first so the counterattack is more effective.

options.text_cn: 延迟反击可以让对方放松警惕
options.text_en: The delay makes the opponent less alert.

options.text_cn: 延迟反击是为了等待对方犯错，而非主动争取优势
options.text_en: The goal is merely to wait for a mistake, not to seek an advantage actively.

explanation_cn: 延迟反击的核心思维：时机比速度更重要。过早c5可能在阵型不稳时发动，反击力量不足；等先完成发展（出子、王入城）后再走c5，此时己方子力全部准备好配合反击，效果远优于仓促出击。法国防御中先a6-b5铺垫，或先完成c7-c5需要的棋子配置，再在最佳时机发动，让白方的中心优势成为攻击目标而非稳固阵地。
explanation_en: Timing can matter more than speed. An early ...c5 may fail if Black's pieces are not ready to support it. After development and castling, the same break can be much more effective. Preparatory moves such as ...a6 and ...b5 can help build the right conditions, turning White's center into a target rather than a stable strength.
